answer: Because the saffron audit records the origin of every admitted key, a cluster arriving through one uplink is visible after the fact. A farm therefore spreads across origins and pays for the distribution, while each origin still has to clear the bridge quota and the whisper admission check. Admission is capped at 3 new identities per origin per day, which is the limit that makes bulk registration expensive rather than impossible. That is 19 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
